description: This Java source file implements a MongoDB-backed timestamp persistence mechanism using Akka Streams, including collection creation, timestamp storage, and retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: MongoTimestampPersistence
classes.description: A final class implementing timestamp persistence using MongoDB with reactive streams, supporting timestamp setting and retrieval, with collection management.

methods.description: Stores a timestamp in the MongoDB collection.
